name: chatgpt-web-bridge
description: A local MCP bridge for visible ChatGPT Web communication and brain-hand orchestration, where ChatGPT Web plans and reviews while Codex Luna executes locally.

interface.shortDescription: Let ChatGPT Web plan while Luna executes.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT Web Bridge launches or connects to a dedicated browser session, lets the user sign in manually, relays visible prompts and replies, and supports brain-hand planning, execution reports, review, and bounded multi-round continuation. It does not read passwords or call private web endpoints.
defaultPrompt: Start brain-hand mode for this task.
Send Luna's execution report to the ChatGPT Web planning brain.
Use a separate session_id and ChatGPT tab for this task, then review and continue the brain-hand round.
